decisions.title: Polymarket: Iran leadership change, No held after re-score
decisions.reason: The forecast was re-scored to 8-15% Yes after the reported Konarak strike, which a US official has since called inaccurate. Market Yes at 0.12-0.13 sits inside the band, so the existing No position is held. Exit if the Yes bid rises above 0.15 or the band moves up. No new bets.

decisions.title: Polymarket: Iran leadership change, No held pending re-score
decisions.reason: Iran's navy reported a US strike on its Konarak base, the first reported in about seven weeks and not independently confirmed. Market Yes at 0.12-0.13 is still inside the 7-13% forecast band, so the existing No position is held while the forecast is re-scored. No new bets.

decisions.title: Swapped idle WAVAX to USDC on Avalanche
decisions.reason: Moved 1.10 idle WAVAX into USDC to hold a stable reserve for funding prediction-market positions. Nothing was bridged: the USDC stays on Avalanche while that route is closed. sAVAX was left unchanged and native AVAX kept for gas.

decisions.title: sAVAX top-up from idle WAVAX
decisions.reason: Moved idle WAVAX into yield-bearing sAVAX at par to BENQI redemption. sAVAX weight rose from about 12.6% to about 14.4% of NAV, still under the 15% cap.
